Team —

Greenwave is ready to sign; legal uploaded the last requested attestation earlier today. Before I send the DocuSign envelope I want to confirm routing and final clean-copy ownership. Key asks: 

- Marissa / Laura: do we have any remaining redline items that require manual countersign or witness?

- External: cc'd James and Sara — plan is to route to their GC (Sara) first, then to VP Ops (James) for signature block finalization. Please advise if that order needs to change.

Attachments: draft MSA clean copy (PDF) and execution plan notes.

Next steps I propose: I prepare the envelope with the two signature blocks and a clean copy attached; set signing order: 1) Sara Jenkins (GC) 2) James Lewis (VP Ops) 3) Redwood countersign (Ethan/Marissa). If legal needs witness/attestation fields we add them as separate tabs.

If I don't hear objections by EOD PT, I'll prepare the envelope and send it to Greenwave tomorrow morning.

Thanks —
Ethan Park
